title: Daily digest: Cyberabad civic body joins hands with UN | Telangana clears 71.23 lakh electors for | Centre seeks States’ help as CJP prepare | Special Control Room Will Address Transp
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / Munsif Daily / The Hindu / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: Cyberabad civic body joins hands with UNICEF India, opens Child Rights Secretariat Cell.
Telangana clears 71.23 lakh electors for inclusion in final voter rolls.
Centre has sought States’ help as CJP prepares to go ahead with protest; major curbs in Delhi.
Special Control Room Will Address Transport Portal Glitches, Says Minister.
bullets_ur: Cyberabad ki civic body ne UNICEF India ke sath mil kar Child Rights Secretariat Cell qaim kar diya
Telangana ne aakhri voter lists mein 71.23 lakh voters ki shamil ki manzoori de di
Markazi hukumat ne States se madad mang li jab CJP ne protest ka faisla kiya, Delhi mein barri pabandiyan
Transport portal ki kharabiyon ko dur karne ke liye special control room banega, wazir ka bayan
